title: Multi-Modal Bias: Introducing a Framework for Stereotypical Bias Assessment beyond Gender and Race in Vision–Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating bias through zero-shot image classification to positive/negative sentiment words, calculating the effect size of cosine similarities (Caliskan test) between religious group embeddings and pleasant/unpleasant attributes, and comparing image-text matching (ITM) probabilities.
